report:
Fresh followup review of the complete sage_chapters claim. Saved and read the previous report/inputs before start, recaptured all prior dependencies, and compared every fragment. The only delta is the unrelated envelope-clause prerequisite comment in spec_plan.rs. The claim, associated ordinary and TODO tests, renderer book.rs, complete book test source, fixture helpers, and captured design/review context are unchanged. No rendering behavior changed.

Full requirement assessment remains partial implementation with explicit deferral. The ordinary test generates actual temporary sources under configured manual/src, supplies matching book.toml/mdBook context, and runs both items and sections protocols. Its exact six-entry chapter inventory includes Design, Crates, two crate overviews, the demo module and original handwritten chapter. Recursive chapters rejects duplicate paths, so equality establishes one occurrence in this fixture. Direct assertions check crate/module names, numbers, parent hierarchy and one nested child. Overview content must include purpose and support dependency; module content must include its declaration and prose. Each Sage chapter must resolve to its corresponding HTML output, contain iframe/full-page controls and the relative shared explorer URL, and have no sibling hand-maintained Markdown file. The local explorer asset must exist, and handwritten chapter JSON remains unchanged.

These assertions substantiate configured placement, basic Crates/overview nesting, source uniqueness in this fixture, static browser embedding, generated local asset and no Markdown copies. They do not execute browser interaction, separately assert the Modules field, exercise every shared-inventory/insertion configuration, or prove offline browser search/navigation/Rust context. Captured book.rs supplies partial supporting machinery: configured source/model loading, generated crate/module hierarchy, source outline purpose/dependencies/modules, explorer embedding and local asset generation. It is supplemental code context, not an ordinary implementation association for complete delivery. The renderer's existence cannot erase the anchor's explicit deferred status.

The sole associated implementation is the TODO region todo::sage_sources_render_as_book_chapters; its paired empty test is also TODO. Its comment expressly defers shared search, declaration links and Rust context independent of Crates chapter insertion. Completion requires associated integrated rendering/inventory behavior and substantive browser-level assertions for those features and server-independent operation across insertion scenarios. The current fixture invokes only preprocessing and demonstrates no server requirement for generation; actual built-book offline operation is still outside its assertions. The ordinary test remains useful partial coverage; neither that passing source test nor the empty TODO establishes the full claim. No N/A entries exist.

The captured Fixture writes real Cargo/book/model files and runs the actual preprocess executable, checking success and decoding output; the chapter helper detects duplicate paths. Both associated test bodies and the entire prior claim accounting were reviewed against unchanged current evidence. The comment-only delta has no effect on any requirement. This review ran start/read/record and source inspection only, no behavior tests, build or browser; central suite execution is separately reported. No source edits or requested edits.
